currency.source: All amounts in Swiss francs of the tax year (Federal Act on Currency and Payment Instruments, WZG)

note: DRAFT for review, not yet a bundled parameter file. Swiss tax and pension parameters for 2026 for a single person, in nominal CHF of 2026. Official pages could not be opened from the research environment; values come from web-search extracts of the official pages named in each source, or from the secondary sources named. Objects flagged verify need checking against the official text; objects flagged complete:false are missing values that a module can't run without. See docs/tax/CH.md.

single.note: Marginal rates of Art. 36 para. 1 DBG; the tax is at most 11.5% of the whole income, which binds from about 793,900. Limits are the 2012-2022 limits (14,500 ... 755,200) indexed by about 5.15%: the 2025 limits moved by 0.1% for 2026 where rounding allowed. The official table gives 10,936.55 at 185,100, which these brackets reproduce (exact to 5 centimes with the table's rounding). The lower limits (15,200 to 58,000) are the 2025 ones and should be checked against Form 58c 2026.
single.source: DBG Art. 36 para. 1 and Art. 39 (cold progression). ESTV, Form. 58c 2026 Alleinstehende: https://www.estv.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/gnde9CmEsalK/dbst-tairfe-58c-2026-dfi.pdf. EFD, 0.1% inflation for 2026: https://www.efd.admin.ch/de/newnsb/VzaAUrhkPx2EPde4a6e3O

indexed.source: DBG Art. 39 para. 2 (full yearly compensation of cold progression)

nextAdjustment.source: EFD, Steuertarife und -abzuege an Teuerung angepasst (tax year 2027): https://www.efd.admin.ch/de/newnsb/rq9rumbCaofX

professionalExpenses.note: Flat deduction for other professional expenses, as a share of net salary. Commuting and meals are separate (otherDeductions).
professionalExpenses.source: Berufskostenverordnung (SR 642.118.1) Art. 7; ESTV, Berufskosten: https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/sm/berufskosten-de-fr.pdf. No change for 2026 (EFD).

commutingMaximum.source: DBG Art. 26 para. 1 lit. a; Kanton Zuerich, ZStB 26.1 (federal cap quoted there): https://www.zh.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/treuhaender/steuerbuch/steuerbuch-definition/zstb-26-1.html

insurancePremiums.note: Single person. 'with' applies to anyone paying into the 2nd pillar or 3a. The planner always takes the maximum (health insurance alone exceeds it).
insurancePremiums.source: DBG Art. 33 para. 1 lit. g and para. 1bis. 1,800 confirmed for 2026 by search extracts; 2,700 from memory of the law.

capitalBenefits.note: Capital benefits from pensions (2nd pillar, vested benefits, 3a) are taxed separately, all of a year's together, at 1/5 of the ordinary tariff.
capitalBenefits.source: DBG Art. 38. Proposal to raise it (Entlastungspaket 27) rejected by both chambers (Dec 2025, Mar 2026): https://www.bdo.ch/de-ch/publikationen/kapitalbezug-vorsorge-steuererhoehung-abgelehnt

dividends.note: Partial taxation of dividends from holdings of at least 10%; other dividends fully taxable.
dividends.source: DBG Art. 20 para. 1bis (as amended by STAF, from 2020)

lumpSumTaxation.note: Taxation on expenditure: the base is at least the highest of the minimum, 7 x the yearly rent or rental value, and the household's living expenses. 434,700 in 2025.
lumpSumTaxation.source: DBG Art. 14. Kanton Uri, Merkblatt Aufwandbesteuerung ab 1.1.2026: https://www.ur.ch/_docn/439772/14_Merkblatt_Aufwandbesteuerung_01.01.2026_1.pdf

employee.note: AHV 4.35%, IV 0.7%, EO 0.25% each side; no ceiling. ALV 1.1% each side up to 148,200; no solidarity contribution above since 2023. Working after the reference age: the first 16,800 a year is free.
employee.source: AHVG Art. 5 and 6; IVG Art. 3; EOG Art. 27; AVIG Art. 3. BSV, Betraege gueltig ab 1. Januar 2026: https://www.bsv.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/sAgdISSXenMT/d_Betr%C3%A4ge%202026.pdf; SECO, ALV-Beitraege: https://www.seco.admin.ch/dam/seco/de/dokumente/Arbeit/ALV/Grundlagen/Faktenblatt_ALV-Beitr%C3%A4ge.pdf.download.pdf/DE_Faktenblatt_ALV-Beitr%C3%A4ge.pdf

selfEmployed.note: AHV 8.1%, IV 1.4%, EO 0.5%. Between 10,100 and 60,500 the official scale rises in steps from 5.371% to 10%; the module interpolates linearly (a few francs' difference). Below 10,100 the minimum contribution applies.
selfEmployed.source: AHVG Art. 8; AHVV Art. 21. AHV/IV, Merkblatt 2.02: https://www.ahv-iv.ch/p/2.02.d; BSV tables: https://sozialversicherungen.admin.ch/de/d/6139/download?version=12

nonEmployed.note: Base: net wealth at 31 December (cantonal tax values, less debts, without 2nd pillar and 3a) + 20 x the year's pension income (all pensions incl. foreign and BVG; not IV pensions or supplementary benefits). Below 350,000 the minimum applies. The step contributions (636 at 350,000; 3,604 at 1,750,000) follow from the published increments and reproduce the maximum at 8,950,000. Due from 1 January after the 20th birthday to the reference age. Compensation offices add admin costs of up to 5%.
nonEmployed.source: AHVG Art. 10; AHVV Art. 28. AHV/IV, Merkblatt 2.03: https://www.ahv-iv.ch/p/2.03.d; SVA Aargau, Beitraege fuer Nichterwerbstaetige 2026: https://www.sva-aargau.ch/ueber-uns/jahresinformation-2026/fuer-privatpersonen/aenderungen-1-januar-2026/beitraege-fuer

indexed.source: AHVG Art. 9bis and 33ter (with the pensions, mixed index of wages and prices)

formula.note: Monthly pension with a full record: fixed share x minimum pension + variable share x average yearly income (13/600 up to 36 x the minimum, 8/600 above), between the minimum and the maximum pension. Partial pension: x Swiss contribution years / 44.

thirteenthPayment.note: Paid each December, 1/12 of the year's old-age pension (first time December 2026).

revaluationFactor.note: For first entries in the individual account from 1986 to 2025, for pensions starting in 2026: earnings count at their nominal value.

earlyWithdrawal.note: 6.8% a year for life (13.6% for two years). New rates based on life expectancy are expected at the earliest for 2027, lower for small incomes.
earlyWithdrawal.source: AHVG Art. 40; AHVV Art. 56. AK Bern, Flexibler Rentenbezug: https://www.akbern.ch/de/AHV-21/Flexibler-Rentenbezug/Flexibler-Rentenbezug.html

deferral.note: Supplement for 1 to 5 years of deferral.
deferral.source: AHVG Art. 39; AHVV Art. 55ter. AK Bern, Flexibler Rentenbezug: https://www.akbern.ch/de/AHV-21/Flexibler-Rentenbezug/Flexibler-Rentenbezug.html

adjustment2027.note: Pensions rise about 1.59% on 1 January 2027 (mixed index). Belongs in 2027.json.
adjustment2027.source: Federal Council decision of autumn 2026, reported by https://www.bluewin.ch/de/news/minimale-ahv-rente-steigt-um-20-franken-li.3621970

ahvPension.source: AHVG Art. 21, 29ter, 34 and 35ter (13th payment). BSV, Betraege gueltig ab 1. Januar 2026: https://www.bsv.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/sAgdISSXenMT/d_Betr%C3%A4ge%202026.pdf; AHV/IV, Merkblatt 3.01: https://www.ahv-iv.ch/p/3.01.d

buyIns.source: BVG Art. 79b para. 3; BVV 2 Art. 60b. Kanton Schwyz, Merkblatt BVG: https://www.sz.ch/public/upload/assets/50127/faq-bvg.pdf

bvg.note: Limits unchanged from 2025; they rise in 2027 with the AHV pensions. Minimum interest 1.25% for 2026.
bvg.source: BVG Art. 2, 7, 8, 13, 14, 15, 16, 37. BSV, Betraege gueltig ab 1. Januar 2026: https://www.bsv.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/sAgdISSXenMT/d_Betr%C3%A4ge%202026.pdf; Allianz, BVG-Kennzahlen 2025/2026 (secondary): https://www.allianz.ch/content/dam/onemarketing/azch/common/allianz/de/allianz-bvg-kennzahlen_zins_umwandlungssaetze.pdf; minimum interest: https://www.finews.ch/news/finanzplatz/70038-bvg-mindestzinssatz-obligatorium-vorsorge-bundesrat

bvgSchemeDefaults.note: Plan assumptions, not law: a typical envelope conversion rate on all assets, its change per year of age, the real interest credited, and Swiss inflation (BVG annuities are nominal). Users should enter their fund's figures.
bvgSchemeDefaults.source: Assumptions for docs/tax/CH.md (fund rules vary; the legal minimum on the mandatory part is 6.8% at 65)

euDeparture.note: Moving to an EU/EFTA state where you're compulsorily insured for old age: only the over-mandatory part can be paid out in cash.

vestedBenefits.source: FZV Art. 16 (as amended from 2024); FZV Art. 12. UBS, Bezug von Freizuegigkeitsguthaben: https://www.ubs.com/ch/de/help/pension/payout-vested-benefit-account.html

retroactivePurchases.note: Only for years with AHV-liable earned income, one payment per gap year, and only once the current year's maximum is paid.
retroactivePurchases.source: BVV 3 Art. 7a (from 2026). Zurich Insurance, Nachtraegliche Einzahlungen Saeule 3a: https://www.zurich.ch/de/services/wissen/vorsorge-und-anlage/nachtraegliche-einkaeufe-saeule-3a

pillar3a.note: Contributions need Swiss earned income subject to AHV. Each account is paid out in full; people hold several accounts to stagger. Early withdrawal on leaving Switzerland, starting self-employment, buying a home or disability.
pillar3a.source: BVV 3 Art. 3 and 7. VZ, Saeule 3a Maximalbetrag 2026: https://www.vermoegenszentrum.ch/wissen/saeule-3a-maximalbetrag

privateCapitalGains.source: DBG Art. 16 para. 3; StHG Art. 7 para. 4 lit. b

professionalTrader.note: Safe harbour of circular 36: all criteria met (plus no debt financing, derivatives only for hedging) means private wealth management. The module only warns.

withholdingTax.source: VStG Art. 4, 5 para. 1 lit. c, 13, 21-23. ESTV, Verrechnungssteuer: https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/ds/d-eidgenoessische-verrechnungssteuer-de.pdf

fundsIncomeTaxedYearly.note: Funds' income is taxable every year whether distributed or accumulated, at the values in the ESTV price list.
fundsIncomeTaxedYearly.source: DBG Art. 20 para. 1 lit. e; ESTV Kursliste/ICTax

imputedRentalValue.note: Abolition approved by voters on 28 September 2025; in force 1 January 2029 (Federal Council, 1 April 2026). Until then the imputed rent is income and mortgage interest (up to investment income + 50,000) and maintenance are deductible.
